{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check for any negative ages, which are implausible
negative_ages = sales_df[sales_df['customer_age'] < 0]

# Check the actual age values for converted customers
converted_ages = sales_df[sales_df['converted'] == 1]['customer_age']

# Compute the mean age of converted customers
mean_age_converted = converted_ages.mean()

# Output the result
negative_ages, mean_age_converted"}
